title: Concept: Requirement ranged with the compatible-release operator
description: requirements.txt declares a `~=` specifier that widens with the leading components, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `~=` specifier that widens with the leading components.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `~=` specifier that widens with the leading components.
